Messages.Author: TorranceCircle
Messages.Body:
Open Dossier
Cost 1 blood
Only usable by a vampire who has been chosen for a contract on the acting minion. This vampire attempts to block with +2 intercept and gets an optional maneuver in the resulting combat if successful. Usable by a tapped vampire even if intercept is not yet needed.

Reading Rev Revolver's comment in another thread made me look at this card again. Does it let you block with a tapped minion? I didn't realize the wording before.

Messages.Author: Robert Scythe
Messages.Body: Usable by a tapped vampire even if intercept is not yet needed.

Messages.Author: ReverendRevolver
Messages.Body:
Of course it does. Thats why if it were free it would make contracts better. And if it untapped the minion playimg it, better still. It SOUNDS like alot of bonus, but having to use a contract to do it balances.

Its just removing the cost and adding "untaps and" before atrempts to block that i suggest.....

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
Correct quote from Robert Scythe.

> ReverednReveolver wrote:
> Its just removing the cost and adding "untaps and" before atrempts to block that i suggest...."
>
Note that this would allow Obedience to be played. Or, if the action isn't blocked, to get an untapped vampire (important for things such as Spirit Marionnette, Harass, Enkil Cog, etc.)

Messages.Author: ReverendRevolver
Messages.Body: Yes, but im ok with that. Contracts suck, and dossier is barely worth playing in non tournament decks as is.
